title: Upload a profile picture
acceptance_criteria:
User Story: Upload a profile picture

Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepted formats are JPG and PNG
- Maximum file size is 5 MB
- Images are resized to 400x400 pixels after upload
- Uploading a new picture replaces the previous one
- If the upload fails, the previous picture is kept and an error is shown

expected_scenarios.description: Valid JPG uploads successfully and becomes the profile picture
Unsupported format (e.g. GIF, PDF) is rejected
File of exactly 5 MB is accepted (boundary)
File just over 5 MB is rejected
New upload replaces the previous picture
Failed upload keeps the previous picture and shows an error
File with a renamed extension (e.g. .exe renamed to .jpg) is rejected
Non-square or very small images are handled when resizing
